fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-07-18, around 14:30, a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 1,85,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-07-23. The complaint was lodged by Dharani Anand (9000000114). The account reference SYN-ACC-100027 was noted in connection with the payment. A further person, Arun Babu, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000379, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complaint mentions Nandha Karuppasamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000113, in connection with the events. Items referenced in the complaint: a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, suspect, call detail, associate, afternoon, mobile number, receiving account
